🎬 Night at the Museum (2006)

🎬 Movie
⭐️ Genre: Adventure, Comedy, Family
🎭 Starring: Ben Stiller, Carla Gugino, Robin Williams

📝 Summary:
Night at the Museum follows Larry Daley, a struggling father who takes a job as a night security guard at the American Museum of Natural History. On his first night, he discovers that a mysterious ancient artifact brings the museum’s exhibits to life after dark. As dinosaurs, historical figures, and other displays come alive, Larry must learn to control the chaos and protect the museum before sunrise.

🔥 Why Watch?

* Fun mix of comedy and adventure
* Ben Stiller’s entertaining performance
* Robin Williams as Teddy Roosevelt
* Creative museum-comes-to-life concept
* Perfect family-friendly entertainment

🏆 Rating: 6.5/10 (IMDb)

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 48m
